<h2 class="scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+64px)] lg:scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+24px)]" id="description">Description:</h2>
<p>Qwen-Image is an image-generation foundation model in the Qwen series. It achieves significant advances in <strong>complex text rendering</strong> (supporting alphabetic scripts such as English and logographic scripts such as Chinese) and <strong>precise image editing</strong> (for example, style transfer, object addition/removal, and pose manipulation). It adopts a multi-module architecture that integrates vision-language encoding and diffusion-based generation, and delivers strong performance in general image generation, text-in-image integration, and classical computer vision tasks (for example, depth estimation and novel-view synthesis).</p>
<p>Qwen-Image was developed by the Qwen Team.<br>
This model is ready for commercial and non-commercial use.</p>

<h2 class="scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+64px)] lg:scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+24px)]" id="model-architecture">Model Architecture:</h2>
<h3 class="scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+64px)] lg:scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+24px)]" id="architecture-type">Architecture Type:</h3>
<p>Qwen-Image adopts a <strong>three-core module architecture</strong>:</p>
<ol>
<li><strong>Multimodal Large Language Model (MLLM)</strong>: Qwen2.5-VL (frozen) for text/image feature extraction and semantic alignment.</li>
<li><strong>Variational AutoEncoder (VAE)</strong>: Single-encoder (frozen, adapted from Wan2.1-VAE) + dual-decoder (image-specific decoder fine-tuned) for image tokenization and reconstruction.</li>
<li><strong>Multimodal Diffusion Transformer (MMDiT)</strong>: Backbone diffusion model with novel <strong>Multimodal Scalable RoPE (MSRoPE)</strong> for joint text-image positional encoding.</li>
</ol>
<h3 class="scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+64px)] lg:scroll-mt-[calc(var(--content-top,var(--app-bar-height))+24px)]" id="network-architecture">Network Architecture:</h3>
<ul>
<li><strong>Key Components</strong>:
<ul>
<li>MSRoPE: Balances image resolution scaling and text positional encoding by mapping text to the diagonal of image grids.</li>
<li>Dual-Encoding Mechanism: Combines semantic features (from Qwen2.5-VL) and reconstructive features (from VAE) for editing consistency.</li>
<li>Multi-Task Training: Integrates T2I (text-to-image), TI2I (text-image-to-image), and I2I (image-to-image reconstruction) tasks.</li>
</ul>
</li>
</ul>
